decisions.quote:
In addition, in contrast to the ﬁndings of Kees and colleagues

(2010), here the moderate graphic examined in Study 2 led to

results that were similar to the high graphic pictorial initially

selected for use by the FDA.
decisions.reason: While the authors replicate Kees et al.'s (2010) main cessation and fear-mediation effects for graphic warnings relative to text-only and low-graphic controls, they explicitly contrast Study 2's null difference between moderate and high graphic warnings with Kees et al.'s (2010) linear finding, yielding a mixed outcome under the codebook.

decisions.quote: The authors use an advertising context to replicate and extend ﬁndings of Kees and colleagues’ (2010) study of the direct and indirect effects of graphic pictorial cigarette warnings.
decisions.reason: The paper explicitly defines its replication target as Kees et al. (2010) and benchmarks its stimuli and hypotheses against that later study by the same author team; Kees et al. (2006) is an earlier study in the same chain cited for background and measures and mentioned alongside the 2010 study in the Study 1 discussion, not a separate target.
